kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace create-dataset-version --dataset-id d-rbvg500000jhc9ks92 --property DIRECTORY --data-source-type OSS --uri oss://mybucket.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/mypath/ --labels example-string --source-type USER --source-id d-a0xbe5n03bhqof46ce --options '{"mountPath":"/mnt/data/"}' --description This_is_a_description_of_the_dataset_version. --data-size 19000 --data-count 300 --import-info '{"region":"cn-wulanchabu","fileSystemId":"bmcpfs-xxxxxxxxxxx","path":"/mnt","mountTarget":"cpfs-xxxxxxxxxxxx-vpc-gacs9f.cn-wulanchabu.cpfs.aliyuncs.com","isVpcMount":true}' --dataset-task-ram-role acs:ram::1234567890123456:role/role-name --user-metrics-endpoints example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatasetVersion

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. For information about how to obtain the dataset ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_zh: 数据集文件数量，单位个
parameters.name: data_count

parameters.help_en: The size of space occupied by dataset files. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 数据集文件占据空间的大小。单位Byte
parameters.name: data_size

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:

NAS: Alibaba Cloud Network Attached Storage (NAS).

OSS: Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS).

CPFS

The DataSourceType of the version must be consistent with the DataSourceType of the dataset. Validation is performed against the dataset when a version is created
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，多项之间使用半角逗号分隔。支持以下取值：

NAS：数据存储为阿里云文件存储（NAS）。

OSS：数据存储为阿里云对象存储（OSS）。

CPFS

注意：当前的策略是版本的DataSourceType 需要与数据集DataSourceType 保持一致，创建版本的时候会和数据集的做校验
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.example: This is a description of the dataset version.
parameters.help_en: The custom description of the dataset version, used to distinguish different dataset versions
parameters.help_zh: 对数据集版本进行自定义描述，以区分不同的数据集版本
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The storage import configuration of the dataset. OSS, NAS, and CPFS are supported.
OSS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"bucket": "${bucket}",//Bucket name
"path": "${path}" //File path
}
NAS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //File system ID
"path": "${path}", //File system path
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //File system mount target
}
CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //File system ID
"protocolServiceId":"${protocol_service_id}", //File system protocol service
"exportId": "${export_id}", //File system export directory
"path": "${path}", //File system path
}
Lingjun CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//Region ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //File system ID
"path": "${path}", //File system path
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //File system mount target, specific to Lingjun edition
"isVpcMount": boolean, //Whether it is a VPC mount target, specific to Lingjun edition
}
parameters.help_zh:
数据集的存储导入配置信息，支持OSS/NAS/CPFS等。
OSS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"bucket": "${bucket}",//bucket名称
"path": "${path}" //文件路径
}
NAS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //文件系统挂载点
}
CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"protocolServiceId":"${protocol_service_id}", //文件系统协议服务
"exportId": "${export_id}", //文件系统导出目录
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
}
智算CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //文件系统挂载点，智算版特有
"isVpcMount": boolean, //是否为vpc挂载点, 智算版特有
}
parameters.name: import_info

parameters.help_en: The list of dataset version labels
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
The extended field in JsonString format.
When DLC uses a dataset, you can specify the default mount path of the dataset by configuring the mountPath field
parameters.help_zh:
扩展字段，JsonString类型。
当DLC使用数据集时，可通过配置mountPath字段指定数据集默认挂载路径
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en:
The property of the dataset. Valid values:
FILE: file.
DIRECTORY: folder
parameters.help_zh:
数据集的属性。支持以下取值：
FILE：文件。
DIRECTORY：文件夹
parameters.name: property

parameters.help_en:
The data source ID.
If SourceType is USER, SourceId can be customized.
If SourceType is ITAG, which indicates a dataset generated from iTAG annotation results, SourceId is the iTAG task ID.
If SourceType is PAI_PUBLIC_DATASET, which indicates a dataset created from a PAI public dataset, SourceId is empty by default
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源ID。
当SourceType为USER时，SourceId支持自定义。
当SourceType为ITAG时，即iTAG模块标注结果生成的数据集时，SourceId为ITAG的任务ID。
当SourceType为PAI_PUBLIC_DATASET时，即使用PAI公共数据集创建的数据集时，SourceId默认为空
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Default value: USER. Valid values:
PAI-PUBLIC-DATASET: PAI public dataset.
ITAG: dataset generated from iTAG annotation results.
USER: user-registered dataset
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源类型，默认为USER。支持以下取值：
PAI-PUBLIC-DATASET：PAI公共数据集。
ITAG：iTAG模块标注结果生成的数据集。
USER：用户注册的数据集
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
Examples of Uri configurations:
If the data source type is OSS: `oss://bucket.endpoint/object`
If the data source type is NAS:
General-purpose NAS format: `nas://<nasfisid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`;
CPFS 1.0: `nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`;
CPFS 2.0: `nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/<protocolserviceid>/`.
CPFS 1.0 and CPFS 2.0 are distinguished by the format of the fsid: CPFS 1.0 format is cpfs-<8 ASCII characters>; CPFS 2.0 format is cpfs-<16 ASCII characters>
parameters.help_zh:
Uri配置样例如下：
数据源类型为OSS：`oss://bucket.endpoint/object`
数据源类型为NAS：
通用型NAS格式为：`nas://<nasfisid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`；
CPFS1.0：`nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`；
CPFS2.0：`nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/<protocolserviceid>/`。
CPFS1.0和CPFS2.0根据fsid的格式来区分：CPFS1.0 格式为cpfs-<8位ASCII字符>；CPFS2.0 格式为cpfs-<16位ASCII字符>
parameters.name: uri
